034/**
035 * Provides functionality to apply and export manual overrides and exclusions
036 * from the PAINT viewer. This class processes recording-level overrides,
037 * square-level overrides, and recording-level exclusions, merging them back
038 * into the main project CSV files.
039 */
040public class ExportOverridesFromViewer {
041
042    /**
043     * Entry point for command-line execution.
044     *
045     * @param args 1 or 2 arguments:
046     *             <ul>
047     *               <li>args[0] → project path</li>
048     *               <li>args[1] → optional extension suffix</li>
049     *             </ul>
050     */
051    public static void main(String[] args) {
052
053        String extension;
054
055        if (args.length != 1 && args.length != 2) {
056            System.err.println("Usage: java -cp paint-viewer.jar paint.viewer.cli.ExportOverridesFromViewer <Project-Path> <Extension>");
057            System.exit(1);
058        }
059
060        Path projectPath = Path.of(args[0]);
061
062        // Optional suffix for newly written CSVs
063        if (args.length == 2) {
064            extension = "-" + args[1];
065        } else {
066            extension = "-override";
067        }
068
069        exportOverrides(projectPath, extension);
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * Executes the full override/exclude procedure on the given project path.
074     *
075     * <p>Inputs are read from the project root. Override/exclude instructions are
076     * read from {@code <project>/Viewer}. Outputs are written back into the
077     * project root with a suffix (default: {@code -override}).</p>
078     *
079     * @param projectPath project root directory
080     * @param extension   suffix added to output CSV files (e.g. {@code -override})
081     */
082    public static void exportOverrides(Path projectPath, String extension) {
083
084        Table                   recordingsTable;
085        Table                   squaresTable;
086        Table                   tracksTable             = null;
087
088        Path                    recordingsCsvPath       = projectPath.resolve(RECORDINGS_CSV);
089        Path                    squaresCsvPath          = projectPath.resolve(SQUARES_CSV);
090        Path                    tracksCsvPath           = projectPath.resolve(TRACKS_CSV);
091
092        Path                    recordingOverridePath   = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Override.csv");
093        Path                    recordingExcludePath    = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Exclude.csv");
094        Path                    squareOverridePath      = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Square Override.csv");
095
096        List<RecordingOverride> recordingOverrides;
097        List<RecordingExclude>  recordingExcludes;
098        List<SquareOverride>    squareOverrides;
099
100        boolean                 recordingsUpdated       = false;
101        boolean                 squaresUpdated          = false;
102        boolean                 tracksUpdated           = false;
103
104        boolean                 recordingExcludeExists  = Files.exists(recordingExcludePath);
105        boolean                 recordingOverrideExists = Files.exists(recordingOverridePath);
106        boolean                 squareOverrideExists    = Files.exists(squareOverridePath);
107
108        // Start logging
109        PaintLogger.infof("Applying manual overrides and exclusions on Squares, Recordings and Tracks");
110        PaintLogger.blankline();
111
112        // Does the project root exist?
113        if (!Files.exists(projectPath) || !Files.isDirectory(projectPath)) {
114            PaintLogger.errorf("Error: Specified Project root '%s' does not exist or is not a directory", projectPath);
115            // Throw (consistent with the other error paths in this method) rather
116            // than System.exit: exportOverrides is called from the viewer GUI, where
117            // exiting would kill the whole application. The GUI caller catches this.
118            throw new RuntimeException("Project root does not exist or is not a directory: " + projectPath);
119        }
120
121
122        ////////////////////////////////////////
123        // Read Squares and Recordings
124        ////////////////////////////////////////
125
126        // Read Squares
127        if (!Files.exists(squaresCsvPath)) {
128            System.err.println("Squares file does not exist: " + squaresCsvPath);
129            PaintLogger.errorf("Squares file '%s' does not exist", squaresCsvPath);
130            throw new RuntimeException();
131        }
132        try {
133            squaresTable = readSquaresTable(projectPath);
134        } catch (Exception e) {
135            PaintLogger.errorf("Squares file '%s' could not be read.",  squaresCsvPath);
136            throw new RuntimeException(e);
137        }
138
139        // Read Recordings
140        if (!Files.exists(recordingsCsvPath)) {
141            System.err.println("Recordings file does not exist: " + recordingsCsvPath);
142            PaintLogger.errorf("Recordings file '%s' does not exist.",  recordingsCsvPath);
143            throw new RuntimeException();
144        }
145        try {
146            recordingsTable = readRecordingsTable(projectPath);
147        } catch (Exception e) {
148            PaintLogger.errorf("Recordings file '%s' could not be read.",  recordingsCsvPath);
149            throw new RuntimeException(e);
150        }
151
152        // Read Tracks but only if there is a 'recording exclude' file
153        if (recordingExcludeExists) {
154            if (!Files.exists(tracksCsvPath)) {
155                System.err.println("Tracks file does not exist: " + tracksCsvPath);
156                PaintLogger.errorf("Tracks file '%s' does not exist.", tracksCsvPath);
157                throw new RuntimeException();
158            }
159            try {
160                tracksTable = readTracksTable(projectPath);
161            } catch (Exception e) {
162                PaintLogger.errorf("Tracks file '%s' could not be read.", recordingsCsvPath);
163                throw new RuntimeException(e);
164            }
165        }
166
167        /////////////////////////////////////////////
168        // Process recordings overrides and excludes
169        /////////////////////////////////////////////
170
171        // Read the Recordings Override if it exists
172        if (recordingOverrideExists) {
173            recordingOverrides = loadRecordingOverride(recordingOverridePath);
174            if (!recordingOverrides.isEmpty()) {
175                applyRecordingOverrides(recordingsTable, squaresTable, recordingOverrides);
176                recordingsUpdated  = true;
177                squaresUpdated     = true;
178            }
179        }
180        else {
181            PaintLogger.infof("No Recording Overrides to apply.");
182        }
183
184        // Read the Recordings Exclude if it exists
185        if (recordingExcludeExists) {
186            recordingExcludes = loadRecordingExclude(recordingExcludePath);
187            if (!recordingExcludes.isEmpty()) {
188                applyRecordingExcludes(recordingsTable, projectPath);
189                recordingsUpdated  = true;
190                squaresUpdated     = true;
191
192                // Delete the corresponding records from Squares and tracks
193                Set<String> excludedRecordingNames = recordingExcludes.stream()
194                                                                      .map(RecordingExclude::getRecordingName)
195                                                                      .collect(Collectors.toSet());
196
197                // Update Squares
198                StringColumn recordingSquaresCol = squaresTable.stringColumn("Recording Name");
199                squaresTable = squaresTable.where(recordingSquaresCol.isNotIn(excludedRecordingNames));
200
201                // Update Tracks
202                StringColumn recordingTracksCol = tracksTable.stringColumn("Recording Name");
203                tracksTable    = tracksTable.where(recordingTracksCol.isNotIn(excludedRecordingNames));
204                tracksUpdated  = true;
205            }
206        }
207        else {
208            PaintLogger.blankline();
209            PaintLogger.infof("No Recording Excludes to apply.");
210        }
211
212        ////////////////////////////////////////
213        // Process squares
214        ////////////////////////////////////////
215
216        if (squareOverrideExists) {
217            squareOverrides = loadSquareOverride(squareOverridePath);
218            if (!squareOverrides.isEmpty()) {
219                applySquareOverrides(squaresTable, squareOverrides);
220                squaresUpdated = true;
221            }
222        }
223        else {
224            PaintLogger.blankline();
225            PaintLogger.infof("No Square Overrides to apply.");
226        }
227
228        // Save files
229        String fileName;
230        if (tracksUpdated || squaresUpdated || recordingsUpdated) {
231            PaintLogger.blankline();
232            PaintLogger.infof("Saving updated files:");
233        }
234        if (recordingsUpdated) {
235            fileName = RECORDINGS_CSV.replaceFirst("(?i)\\.csv$", "");   // remove .csv (any case)
236            fileName = fileName + extension + ".csv";
237            Path overrideRecordingsCsvPath = projectPath.resolve(fileName);
238            writeSpecificRecordingsFile(overrideRecordingsCsvPath, recordingsTable);
239            PaintLogger.infof("     Saved updated Recordings file : " + overrideRecordingsCsvPath);
240        }
241
242        if (squaresUpdated) {
243            fileName = SQUARES_CSV.replaceFirst("(?i)\\.csv$", "");   // remove .csv (any case)
244            fileName = fileName + extension + ".csv";
245            Path overrideSquaresCsvPath = projectPath.resolve(fileName);
246            writeSpecificSquaresFile(overrideSquaresCsvPath, squaresTable);
247            PaintLogger.infof("     Saved updated Squares file    : " + overrideSquaresCsvPath);
248        }
249
250        if (tracksUpdated) {
251            fileName = TRACKS_CSV.replaceFirst("(?i)\\.csv$", "");   // remove .csv (any case)
252            fileName = fileName + extension + ".csv";
253            Path overrideTracksCsvPath = projectPath.resolve(fileName);
254            writeSpecificTracksFile(overrideTracksCsvPath, tracksTable);
255            PaintLogger.infof("     Saved updated Tracks file     : " + overrideTracksCsvPath);
256        }
257    }
258
259    /**
260     * Applies all {@link RecordingOverride} rows to the recordings table and
261     * recomputes square visibility for affected recordings.
262     *
263     * @param recordingsTable target Recordings table (mutated in-place)
264     * @param squaresTable    target Squares table (mutated in-place)
265     * @param overrides       parsed override rows
266     */
267    public static void applyRecordingOverrides(Table recordingsTable, Table squaresTable, List<RecordingOverride> overrides) {
268
269        Map<String, RecordingOverride> map = new HashMap<>();
270        for (RecordingOverride override : overrides) {
271            map.put(key(override.getExperimentName(), override.getRecordingName()), override);
272        }
273
274        PaintLogger.infof("Processing Recording overrides - different selection criteria for squares in recording:" );
275        PaintLogger.blankline();
276
277        // The squares are converted to objects once, filtered for every overridden recording,
278        // and converted back once.
279        //
280        // This used to happen inside the loop: each overridden recording converted the *entire*
281        // squares table to a list, filtered its own recording's squares, converted the whole
282        // thing back, and rebuilt the table. Overriding at Project scope therefore did that
283        // once per recording - quadratic in the number of squares, for no benefit, since
284        // applyVisibilityFilterOnRecording only ever touches the squares of the one recording
285        // it is given.
286        //
287        // The list is built lazily, so a project with no matching overrides converts nothing.
288        List<Square> squareList  = null;
289        boolean      anyOverride = false;
290
291        for (int row = 0; row < recordingsTable.rowCount(); row++) {
292            String            experimentName = recordingsTable.stringColumn(EXPERIMENT_NAME).get(row);
293            String            recordingName  = recordingsTable.stringColumn(RECORDING_NAME).get(row);
294            RecordingOverride override       = map.get(key(experimentName, recordingName));
295
296            if (override == null) {
297                continue;
298            }
299
300            // Update columns directly in the table
301            recordingsTable.doubleColumn(MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO).set( row, override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
302            recordingsTable.doubleColumn(MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED).set(     row, override.getMinRequiredRSquared());
303            recordingsTable.doubleColumn(MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY).set(  row, override.getMaxAllowableVariability());
304            recordingsTable.stringColumn(NEIGHBOUR_MODE).set(             row, override.getNeighbourMode());
305
306            // LOG full detail for this recording
307            PaintLogger.infof("    Applied Recording override on %s", recordingName);
308
309            PaintLogger.infof("          Density Ratio:  %-6.2f",  override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
310            PaintLogger.infof("          R²:             %-6.2f",  override.getMinRequiredRSquared());
311            PaintLogger.infof("          Variability:    %-6.2f ", override.getMaxAllowableVariability());
312            PaintLogger.infof("          Neighbour Mode: %-6s",    override.getNeighbourMode());
313            PaintLogger.blankline();
314
315            if (squareList == null) {
316                squareList = squareTableToList(squaresTable);
317            }
318
319            // Apply the new selection criteria to this recording's squares
320            applyVisibilityFilterOnRecording(
321                    squareList,
322                    recordingName,
323                    override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio(),
324                    override.getMaxAllowableVariability(),
325                    override.getMinRequiredRSquared(),
326                    override.getNeighbourMode());
327
328            anyOverride = true;
329        }
330
331        if (anyOverride) {
332            Table updatedSquaresTable = squareListToTable(squareList);
333            squaresTable.clear();                   // Clear and append, rather than reassign, so that
334            squaresTable.append(updatedSquaresTable);   // references held by the caller stay valid.
335        }
336    }
337
338    /**
339     * Applies all {@link SquareOverride} rows to the squares table.
340     *
341     * <p>Only rows matching the composite key
342     * {@code (experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber)} are updated.</p>
343     *
344     * @param squaresTable target Squares table (mutated in-place)
345     * @param overrides    parsed override rows
346     */
347    public static void applySquareOverrides(Table squaresTable, List<SquareOverride> overrides) {
348
349        PaintLogger.infof("Processing Square overrides - different cell IDs for squares:");
350        // Build lookup map: "exp§rec§squareNumber" → SquareOverride
351        Map<String, SquareOverride> overrideCellIds = new java.util.HashMap<>();
352
353        for (SquareOverride override : overrides) {
354            String key = key(override.getExperimentName(),
355                             override.getRecordingName(),
356                             override.getSquareNumber());
357            overrideCellIds.put(key, override);
358        }
359
360        int applied = 0;
361
362        for (int row = 0; row < squaresTable.rowCount(); row++) {
363
364            String experimentName = squaresTable.stringColumn(EXPERIMENT_NAME).get(row);
365            String recordingName = squaresTable.stringColumn(RECORDING_NAME).get(row);
366            int squareNumber = squaresTable.intColumn(SQUARE_NUMBER).get(row);
367
368            String key = key(experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber);
369            SquareOverride override = overrideCellIds.get(key);
370
371            if (override != null) {
372                squaresTable.intColumn(CELL_ID).set(row, override.getCellId());
373                applied++;
374            }
375        }
376
377        if (applied > 0) {
378            Map<String, Long> squaresPerRecording =
379                    overrides.stream()
380                             .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(
381                                     SquareOverride::getRecordingName,
382                                     Collectors.counting()
383                             ));
384
385            PaintLogger.blankline();
386            PaintLogger.infof("Applied squares overrides:");
387            for (String rec : squaresPerRecording.keySet()) {
388                PaintLogger.infof("                    %s: %d squares", rec, squaresPerRecording.get(rec));
389            }
390        }
391    }

394    /**
395     * Applies recording excludes from {@code Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv} by
396     * setting the "Exclude" flag in the provided Recordings table.
397     *
398     * <p>This method does not delete rows from other tables; the caller may
399     * choose to remove excluded recordings from Squares/Tracks.</p>
400     *
401     * @param recordingsTable target Recordings table (mutated in-place)
402     * @param projectPath     project root directory
403     */
404    public static void applyRecordingExcludes(Table recordingsTable, Path projectPath) {
405
406        PaintLogger.infof("Processing Recordings that were exclude");
407        Path csvPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Exclude.csv");
408
409        List<RecordingExclude> excludes = loadRecordingExclude(csvPath);
410
411        BooleanColumn excludeCol = recordingsTable.booleanColumn("Exclude");
412
413        for (int i = 0; i < excludeCol.size(); i++) {
414            excludeCol.set(i, false);
415        }
416
417        boolean first = true;
418        for (RecordingExclude exclude : excludes) {
419            StringColumn  nameCol      = recordingsTable.stringColumn("Recording Name");
420            String        recordingName = exclude.getRecordingName();
421
422            for (int row = 0; row < recordingsTable.rowCount(); row++) {
423                if (recordingName.equals(nameCol.get(row))) {
424                    excludeCol.set(row, true);
425                    if (first) {
426                        PaintLogger.blankline();
427                        first = false;
428                    }
429                    PaintLogger.infof("    Recording excluded: " + recordingName);
430                    break;
431                }
432            }
433        }
434    }
435
436    /** Composite key utility for (experiment, recording, squareNumber). */
437    private static String key(String exp, String rec, int sq) {
438        return exp + "§" + rec + "§" + sq;
439    }
440
441    /** Composite key utility for (experiment, recording). */
442    private static String key(String exp, String rec) {
443        return exp + "§" + rec;
444    }
